# Laura Jorden | Scottsdale Luxury Real Estate Advisor, Compass

> Laura Jorden is a Scottsdale luxury real estate advisor with Compass, recognized by RealTrends and The Wall Street Journal as one of the top 1.5% of REALTORS® in America. She has been a licensed Arizona REALTOR® since 2005 (license #SA564224000) and a Valley resident for more than 35 years. Laura works solo by choice: every client works with her personally, from the first conversation to closing, and is never handed off to a team. When a seller wants added coverage, she is open to co-listing with another agent when it serves the client.

## Key Facts
- Title: Scottsdale luxury real estate advisor
- Brokerage: Compass
- Recognition: Top 1.5% of REALTORS® in America (RealTrends and The Wall Street Journal). RealTrends Verified spotlights the top 1.5% of real estate professionals, and Laura is listed as a RealTrends Verified Top Agent by Volume in Arizona: https://www.realtrends.com/agent-profile/laura-jorden-arizona/
- Licensed since: 2005 (Arizona)
- Arizona resident: 35+ years
- Works solo (not a team); open to co-listing when it serves the client
- Education: Indiana University — degrees in Chemistry and Economics, minor in Biology
- Member: Top Agent Network since 2023 (independently verified top 10% agent in the Scottsdale market) — https://topagentnetwork.com/agent/laura-jorden
- Member: Luxury Home Tour
- Community: former board member, Scottsdale Unified Schools (Sequoya and Cocopah) and Phoenix Rising; former team manager, Phoenix Rising and SC Del Sol Soccer Club
- Approach: data-driven pricing and negotiation; gives clients clear market data so they can decide with confidence

## Sales Track Record
Source: Laura Jorden's closed residential sales in ARMLS (Arizona Regional MLS), 2005 through October 22, 2026, as listing or buyer's agent.
- Total: 101 closed sales, $110.6 million in volume; average sale price $1.09 million; sellers averaged 97% of list price
- 35 sales of $1 million or more; 12 of $2 million or more; 7 of $3 million or more; highest sale $9.8 million (North Scottsdale, 2022)
- 2025: 15 closed sales, $17.3 million
- Shea-Tatum corridor / Phoenix Mountain Preserve (85028): 4 sales, $10.0 million, highest $4.85 million (2026)
- Town of Paradise Valley: 3 sales, $9.4 million, highest $3.9 million
- North Scottsdale (85255, 85262): 9 sales, $25.3 million, highest $9.8 million
- Shea and Cactus Corridor (85254): 11 sales, $10.5 million
- McCormick Ranch and Gainey Ranch (85258): 4 sales, $4.0 million, highest $1.8 million
- Scottsdale overall: 51 sales, $66.2 million
- Biltmore: highest sale $1.41 million (2024)
- Fountain Hills: 2 sales, highest $1.17 million
